title: Uniform-in-time square-root Hele–Shaw convergence for singular-pressure flows with uniformly convex confining and compatible interaction potentials
author: Noemi David; Alpár R. Mészáros; Filippo Santambrogio
work: Improved convergence rates for the Hele-Shaw limit in the presence of confining potentials
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 13 (2026), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.322
difficulty_reason: Contractivity and the general transport derivative do not bound the singular nonlinear diffusion defect when densities can vanish and there is no common positive lower bound. The authors combine the Monge–Ampere density ratio with the pressure complementarity and the sign of the singular Laplacian to obtain a uniform O(epsilon) defect, then symmetrize the interaction drift and isolate the barycenter term for both convexity alternatives. This quantitative free-boundary/transport comparison is the nonroutine remaining obligation beyond the precise prior existence, optimal-transport and Grönwall foundations.
